grain_rationale: One source row is one hourly weather observation at one airport: the profile shows row_count 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, and 3 distinct airport_code values combined with 4341 distinct observed_hour_utc values (3 x 4341 = 13023, approximately the row count allowing for a few missing station-hours) indicates the (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) tuple identifies a row. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count, 4341 for observed_hour_utc, is well below row_count), so a derived identity over that tuple is declared. With duplicate_row_rate at 0.0 there are no exact duplicates for the identity to absorb.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: IATA code of the observing airport; the profile shows exactly three values (EWR, JFK, LGA) with null_rate 0.0, identifying the station for each observation.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the observation hour; samples such as 2013-01-01T06:00:00 resolve to whole hours (minutes always :00) spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-07-01 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (181 distinct dates from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30, null_rate 0.0), a label alongside the UTC event time rather than the event time itself.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of day (0 through 23, 24 distinct values, null_rate 0.0); a numeric label of when the observation occurred locally, not a quantity to be summed.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, ranging from 10.94 to 93.92 in the profile with null_rate 0.0, compared and averaged across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, ranging from -9.94 to 73.94 with null_rate 0.0, compared across observations as a measure.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage from 12.74 to 100.0 with null_rate 0.0, a continuous measurement compared across observations.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Compass wind direction in degrees (0 to 360 in steps of 10 per the samples); nullable at null_rate 0.016828, likely absent when wind is calm or direction is unreported, and treated as a dimension because degrees label a direction rather than measure a quantity.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour from 0.0 to 1048.36058 (the max suggests occasional sensor outliers); nullable at null_rate 0.000154 for a handful of unreported readings.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Peak wind gust in miles per hour from 16.11092 to 62.14212; nullable at null_rate 0.745505 because gusts are only reported when they occur.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Hourly precipitation in inches from 0.0 to 1.06 with null_rate 0.0, an additive quantity summed across hours.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Sea-level pressure in millibars from 983.8 to 1038.4; nullable at null_rate 0.114953, suggesting the barometric reading is not reported every hour.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles reported on a 20-value scale from 0.0 to 10.0 with null_rate 0.0, compared across observations as a measure.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name with three distinct values (e.g. John F. Kennedy International Airport) and null_rate 0.0, a descriptive label for the station.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality the airport serves, two distinct values (New York, Newark) with null_rate 0.0, a geographic label.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet with three distinct values (13, 18, 21) matching the three stations and null_rate 0.0; a static attribute of the airport, not a quantity summed across rows.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the airport's longest runway in feet with three distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511) matching the three stations and null_rate 0.0; a static airport attribute used as a label.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp with three distinct values within seconds of each other on 2026-09-02 and null_rate 0.0, a load-batch label rather than an event time.

category_description: One row is one hourly weather observation recorded at one of three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), carrying the measured conditions for that station-hour (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) together with static attributes of the observing airport.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_airport_weather enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category: it names the event time column and its hour grain, declares the transaction grain with a derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc), and assigns every silver column a role. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which renders the gold models from this contract.
usage: The proposal is rendered to an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only the approved contract drives model generation, and nothing in this proposal executes directly.
limitations: The mapping names silver columns as-is and declares no transformations, filters, quality rules, or derived columns beyond the declared line identity. It does not exclude or correct suspect readings such as the wind_speed_mph maximum of 1048.36058 mph, does not impute the nulls in wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (0.114953), wind_dir_degrees (0.016828), or wind_speed_mph (0.000154), and leaves local-time versus UTC reporting choices to consumers via the observed_date_local and observed_hour_local dimensions.
